decisions.reason: The image requirement already applies to every blog article; increasing the article count does not change its image rules or scope.
The source changes only the number of blog articles and does not change the existing word-count threshold or qualifier.
The approval gate already applies to individual blog articles and remains unchanged when the article count increases.
The existing internal-link requirement applies generally to blog articles; the source does not change its destinations, purposes, or publication prerequisite.
Increasing the article count neither selects new topics nor resolves or changes the existing topic ambiguity.
The audience requirement is specific to the AI dolls blog, and the source does not identify the topics or audiences of the additional articles.
The source increases the production count but does not independently require publication of the additional articles or change the existing publication behavior.
The source does not add, remove, or replace any blog keyword target.
The additional blog articles do not entail any change to backlink count, backlink types, or backlink percentages.
The article-count increase does not change the website keyword-research deliverable or its target keyword count.
The source concerns additional blog articles and does not affect whether search-volume data must be included in the keyword list.
The source does not change the approved webpage replacement terms or the scope of the webpage content update.
